◆ start_periodic_lease_poll()

void DhcpTask::start_periodic_lease_poll ( const std::chrono::milliseconds &  delay_ms)
private

Start periodical DHCP IPv4/IPv6 lease poll with timer.

Periodic lease polls are triggered with timer. Leases are read from bpl::dhcp_get_leases() within timer handler. After reading leases, database objects are filled.

Period of this timer is config.dhcp_monitor_interval_seconds. Timer delay is passed as argument to control timers delay.

If periodical timer is already started, removes and adds again. Timer restarted with new delay_ms.

Parameters
delay_msdelay timeout time in miliseconds.
